blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Find the maximum or minimum point by sketching the following quadratic function. Also find its domain and range: \(f(x) = x^2 - 4x\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh quadratic function hai, is ka graph parabola hota hai. \(a > 0\) hai, is liye parabola ooper (U-shape) khulta hai aur us ka vertex minimum point hoga.
Humein graph sketch karna hai, vertex mark karna hai, aur domain aur range batani hai. Sketch (khaka) ka matlab hai ke har point naap tol kar lagane ki zaroorat nahin, lekin vertex aur intercepts sahih jagah par hon.
Plan: \(h = -\frac{b}{2a}\) aur \(k = f(h)\) se vertex, phir intercepts, phir vertex ke dono taraf values ki table, aur aakhir mein graph se domain aur range parhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = x^2 - 4x\), yani \(a = 1,\ b = -4,\ c = 0\).
Humein find karna hai: sketch se minimum point, domain aur range.
Tareeqa: parabola teen cheezon se pehchana jata hai: kis taraf khulta hai, vertex kahan hai, aur chand points. Vertex woh mor (turning point) hai jahan curve palat-ta hai; yahi maximum ya minimum point hota hai.

Parabola kis taraf khulta hai
\[a = 1 \Rightarrow a > 0\]
Kyun: agar \(a > 0\) ho to parabola ooper khulta hai, jaise muskurahat, aur vertex sab se neecha point hota hai; agar \(a < 0\) ho to neeche khulta hai, jaise udaas chehra, aur vertex sab se ooncha point hota hai. Yahan parabola ooper (U-shape) khulta hai, is liye humein minimum talaash karna hai.

Vertex \((h, k)\)
\[h = -\dfrac{b}{2a} = -\dfrac{-4}{2(1)} = 2\]
\[k = f(2) = 4 - 8 = -4\]
Vertex \(V(2,\ -4)\); axis of symmetry (tanazur ki lakeer) \(x = 2\).
Kyun: vertex hamesha axis of symmetry \(x = -\frac{b}{2a}\) par hota hai, aur us ki oonchai \(f(h)\) hai. Completing square se bhi yahi milta hai: \(f(x) = (x - 2)^2 - 4\).
Dhyan dein: formula mein \(b\) ka sign samet istemal karein; \(-\frac{b}{2a}\) mein do minus mil kar plus bhi ban sakte hain.

Intercepts (axes ko kaatne wale points)
\[f(0) = 0\]
\[x^2 - 4x = 0\]
\[x(x - 4) = 0\]
\[x = 0 \text{ or } x = 4\]
y-intercept \((0, 0)\); x-intercepts \((0, 0)\) aur \((4, 0)\).
Kyun: y-axis par har point ka \(x = 0\) hota hai, aur x-axis par \(f(x) = 0\). In points se graph ki jagah pakki ho jati hai.

Values ki table
\[x:\ 0,\ 1,\ 2,\ 3,\ 4\]
\[f(x):\ 0,\ -3,\ -4,\ -3,\ 0\]
Kyun: vertex ke dono taraf \(x\) ki values li hain. Dekhiye, outputs \(x = 2\) ke dono taraf aaine ki tarah dohraye ja rahe hain; yeh symmetry hamare hisaab ki tasdeeq bhi hai. Agar kahin values barabar na aayein to hisaab dobara dekhein.

Sketch
Points ko graph par lagayein, unhein smooth curve se jorein (seedhi lakeeron se nahin) aur dashed line \(x = 2\) bana dein (figure dekhiye). Mor ka point \(V(2,\ -4)\) hai.
Kyun: graph saaf dikhata hai ke curve vertex se neeche kabhi nahin jata, is liye \(V\) hi minimum point hai. Exam mein graph par vertex, axis of symmetry aur intercepts ke labels zaroor likhein; yahi cheezein marks dilati hain.

Domain aur range
\[\text{Domain } f = (-\infty,\ \infty)\]
\[\text{Range } f = [-4,\ \infty)\]
Kyun: polynomial mein koi bhi real \(x\) rakha ja sakta hai, na koi denominator hai na square root, is liye domain tamam real numbers hain. Outputs vertex ki oonchai \(-4\) se shuru hote hain (yeh value \(x = 2\) par waqai milti hai, is liye square bracket) aur ooper be-had tak jate hain, yani \(f(x) \ge -4\).
Dhyan dein: infinity ki taraf hamesha gol bracket lagta hai, kyun ke infinity koi number nahin jo haasil ho sake.

Tasdeeq
\[f(x) = (x - 2)^2 - 4\]
Kyun: is square wali shakal ko khol kar dekhein to wapas \(x^2 - 4x\) milta hai, aur is se seedha nazar aata hai ke minimum value \(-4\) hai; yeh sketch se mil gaya.
Khud sochiye: agar function \(x^2 - 4x + 5\) hota to graph sirf 5 ooper khisak jata; vertex \((2, 1)\) ho jata aur range \([1, \infty)\). Constant badalne se sirf oonchai badalti hai, axis \(x = 2\) wahi rehta hai.
blocks.final_answer: Minimum point \(V(2,\ -4)\), yani minimum value \(-4\) jo \(x = 2\) par hai; Domain \(f = (-\infty,\ \infty)\); Range \(f = [-4,\ \infty)\).

answer_figure.alt: Upward parabola f(x) = x squared minus 4x through (0, 0) and (4, 0), with its lowest point V(2, -4) on the dashed axis of symmetry x = 2.
answer_figure.caption: Question 2 (i): sketch of f(x) = x² - 4x with its minimum point (original drawing)

Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = x^2 - 5x + 6\), yani \(a = 1,\ b = -5,\ c = 6\). Vertex x-axis se sirf \(\tfrac{1}{4}\) neeche hai, aur bilkul roots 2 aur 3 ke darmiyan (\(\tfrac{2 + 3}{2} = 2.5\)) hai.

Vertex \((h, k)\)
\[h = -\dfrac{-5}{2(1)} = \dfrac{5}{2}\]
\[k = \left(\tfrac{5}{2}\right)^2 - 5\left(\tfrac{5}{2}\right) + 6\]
\[k = \tfrac{25}{4} - \tfrac{50}{4} + \tfrac{24}{4} = -\tfrac{1}{4}\]

Intercepts (axes ko kaatne wale points)
\[f(0) = 6\]
\[x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0\]
\[(x - 2)(x - 3) = 0\]
\[x = 2 \text{ or } x = 3\]
y-intercept \((0, 6)\); x-intercepts \((2, 0)\) aur \((3, 0)\).
Kyun: y-axis par har point ka \(x = 0\) hota hai, aur x-axis par \(f(x) = 0\). In points se graph ki jagah pakki ho jati hai.

\[x:\ 0,\ 1,\ 2,\ 2.5,\ 3,\ 4,\ 5\]

Kyun: graph saaf dikhata hai ke curve vertex se neeche kabhi nahin jata, is liye \(V\) hi minimum point hai. Exam mein graph par vertex, axis of symmetry aur intercepts ke labels zaroor likhein; yahi cheezein marks dilati hain.

Domain aur range
\[\text{Domain } f = (-\infty,\ \infty)\]
\[\text{Range } f = \left[-\tfrac{1}{4},\ \infty\right)\]
Kyun: polynomial mein koi bhi real \(x\) rakha ja sakta hai, na koi denominator hai na square root, is liye domain tamam real numbers hain. Outputs vertex ki oonchai \(-\tfrac{1}{4}\) se shuru hote hain (yeh value \(x = \tfrac{5}{2}\) par waqai milti hai, is liye square bracket) aur ooper be-had tak jate hain, yani \(f(x) \ge -\tfrac{1}{4}\).
Dhyan dein: infinity ki taraf hamesha gol bracket lagta hai, kyun ke infinity koi number nahin jo haasil ho sake.

Tasdeeq
\[f(x) = \left(x - \tfrac{5}{2}\right)^2 - \tfrac{1}{4}\]
Kyun: is square wali shakal ko khol kar dekhein to wapas \(x^2 - 5x + 6\) milta hai, aur is se seedha nazar aata hai ke minimum value \(-\tfrac{1}{4}\) hai; yeh sketch se mil gaya.
Khud sochiye: jab do x-intercepts hon to vertex hamesha un ke bilkul beech mein hota hai. Is liye \(h = \tfrac{2 + 3}{2} = 2.5\) aik doosra aasaan raasta bhi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Find the maximum or minimum point by sketching the following quadratic function. Also find its domain and range: \(f(x) = -x^2 + 2x - 8\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh quadratic function hai, is ka graph parabola hota hai. \(a < 0\) hai, is liye parabola neeche (ulta U) khulta hai aur us ka vertex maximum point hoga.
Humein graph sketch karna hai, vertex mark karna hai, aur domain aur range batani hai. Sketch (khaka) ka matlab hai ke har point naap tol kar lagane ki zaroorat nahin, lekin vertex aur intercepts sahih jagah par hon.
Plan: \(h = -\frac{b}{2a}\) aur \(k = f(h)\) se vertex, phir intercepts, phir vertex ke dono taraf values ki table, aur aakhir mein graph se domain aur range parhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = -x^2 + 2x - 8\), yani \(a = -1,\ b = 2,\ c = -8\).
Humein find karna hai: sketch se maximum point, domain aur range.
Tareeqa: parabola teen cheezon se pehchana jata hai: kis taraf khulta hai, vertex kahan hai, aur chand points. Vertex woh mor (turning point) hai jahan curve palat-ta hai; yahi maximum ya minimum point hota hai.

Parabola kis taraf khulta hai
\[a = -1 \Rightarrow a < 0\]
Kyun: agar \(a > 0\) ho to parabola ooper khulta hai, jaise muskurahat, aur vertex sab se neecha point hota hai; agar \(a < 0\) ho to neeche khulta hai, jaise udaas chehra, aur vertex sab se ooncha point hota hai. Yahan parabola neeche (ulta U) khulta hai, is liye humein maximum talaash karna hai.

Vertex \((h, k)\)
\[h = -\dfrac{2}{2(-1)} = 1\]
\[k = f(1) = -1 + 2 - 8 = -7\]
Vertex \(V(1,\ -7)\); axis of symmetry (tanazur ki lakeer) \(x = 1\).
Kyun: vertex hamesha axis of symmetry \(x = -\frac{b}{2a}\) par hota hai, aur us ki oonchai \(f(h)\) hai. Completing square se bhi yahi milta hai: \(f(x) = -(x - 1)^2 - 7\).
Dhyan dein: formula mein \(b\) ka sign samet istemal karein; \(-\frac{b}{2a}\) mein do minus mil kar plus bhi ban sakte hain.

Intercepts (axes ko kaatne wale points)
\[f(0) = -8\]
\[-x^2 + 2x - 8 = 0\]
\[x^2 - 2x + 8 = 0\]
\[b^2 - 4ac = 4 - 32 = -28 < 0\]
y-intercept \((0, -8)\); x-intercept koi nahin.
Kyun: y-axis par har point ka \(x = 0\) hota hai, aur x-axis par \(f(x) = 0\). In points se graph ki jagah pakki ho jati hai. Discriminant negative hai, matlab equation ka koi real root nahin, yani parabola x-axis ko kabhi nahin chhoota. Vertex khud x-axis ke neeche hai aur parabola neeche hi khulta hai, is liye poora graph x-axis ke neeche rehta hai.

Values ki table
\[x:\ -1,\ 0,\ 1,\ 2,\ 3\]
\[f(x):\ -11,\ -8,\ -7,\ -8,\ -11\]
Kyun: vertex ke dono taraf \(x\) ki values li hain. Dekhiye, outputs \(x = 1\) ke dono taraf aaine ki tarah dohraye ja rahe hain; yeh symmetry hamare hisaab ki tasdeeq bhi hai. Agar kahin values barabar na aayein to hisaab dobara dekhein.

Sketch
Points ko graph par lagayein, unhein smooth curve se jorein (seedhi lakeeron se nahin) aur dashed line \(x = 1\) bana dein (figure dekhiye). Mor ka point \(V(1,\ -7)\) hai.
Kyun: graph saaf dikhata hai ke curve vertex se ooper kabhi nahin jata, is liye \(V\) hi maximum point hai. Exam mein graph par vertex, axis of symmetry aur intercepts ke labels zaroor likhein; yahi cheezein marks dilati hain.

Domain aur range
\[\text{Domain } f = (-\infty,\ \infty)\]
\[\text{Range } f = (-\infty,\ -7]\]
Kyun: polynomial mein koi bhi real \(x\) rakha ja sakta hai, na koi denominator hai na square root, is liye domain tamam real numbers hain. Outputs vertex ki oonchai \(-7\) se shuru hote hain (yeh value \(x = 1\) par waqai milti hai, is liye square bracket) aur neeche be-had tak jate hain, yani \(f(x) \le -7\).
Dhyan dein: infinity ki taraf hamesha gol bracket lagta hai, kyun ke infinity koi number nahin jo haasil ho sake.

Tasdeeq
\[f(x) = -(x - 1)^2 - 7\]
Kyun: is square wali shakal ko khol kar dekhein to wapas \(-x^2 + 2x - 8\) milta hai, aur is se seedha nazar aata hai ke maximum value \(-7\) hai; yeh sketch se mil gaya.
Khud sochiye: x-intercept na hone ke bawajood graph banana mushkil nahin; vertex, y-intercept aur symmetry kaafi hain. \((0, -8)\) ka aaina \((2, -8)\) hai, kyun ke dono \(x = 1\) se aik aik unit door hain.
blocks.final_answer: Maximum point \(V(1,\ -7)\), yani maximum value \(-7\) jo \(x = 1\) par hai; Domain \(f = (-\infty,\ \infty)\); Range \(f = (-\infty,\ -7]\).

answer_figure.alt: Downward parabola f(x) = -x squared plus 2x minus 8 lying wholly below the x-axis, through (0, -8), with its highest point V(1, -7) on the dashed line x = 1.
answer_figure.caption: Question 2 (iii): sketch of f(x) = -x² + 2x - 8 with its maximum point (original drawing)

Kyun: vertex ke dono taraf \(x\) ki values li hain. Dekhiye, outputs \(x = -1\) ke dono taraf aaine ki tarah dohraye ja rahe hain; yeh symmetry hamare hisaab ki tasdeeq bhi hai. Agar kahin values barabar na aayein to hisaab dobara dekhein.

Sketch
Points ko graph par lagayein, unhein smooth curve se jorein (seedhi lakeeron se nahin) aur dashed line \(x = -1\) bana dein (figure dekhiye). Mor ka point \(V(-1,\ -9.3)\) hai.
Kyun: graph saaf dikhata hai ke curve vertex se neeche kabhi nahin jata, is liye \(V\) hi minimum point hai. Exam mein graph par vertex, axis of symmetry aur intercepts ke labels zaroor likhein; yahi cheezein marks dilati hain.

Domain aur range
\[\text{Domain } f = (-\infty,\ \infty)\]
\[\text{Range } f = [-9.3,\ \infty)\]
Kyun: polynomial mein koi bhi real \(x\) rakha ja sakta hai, na koi denominator hai na square root, is liye domain tamam real numbers hain. Outputs vertex ki oonchai \(-9.3\) se shuru hote hain (yeh value \(x = -1\) par waqai milti hai, is liye square bracket) aur ooper be-had tak jate hain, yani \(f(x) \ge -9.3\).
Dhyan dein: infinity ki taraf hamesha gol bracket lagta hai, kyun ke infinity koi number nahin jo haasil ho sake.

Tasdeeq
\[f(x) = (x + 1)^2 - 9.3\]
Kyun: is square wali shakal ko khol kar dekhein to wapas \(x^2 + 2x - 8.3\) milta hai, aur is se seedha nazar aata hai ke minimum value \(-9.3\) hai; yeh sketch se mil gaya.
Khud sochiye: \(\sqrt{9.3}\) taqreeban 3.05 hai, kyun ke \(3^2 = 9\) aur \(3.05^2 \approx 9.30\). Is liye roots \(-1 + 3.05 \approx 2.05\) aur \(-1 - 3.05 \approx -4.05\) hain.
blocks.final_answer: Minimum point \(V(-1,\ -9.3)\), yani minimum value \(-9.3\) jo \(x = -1\) par hai; Domain \(f = (-\infty,\ \infty)\); Range \(f = [-9.3,\ \infty)\).

blocks.prompt: 2 (vi) Find the maximum or minimum point by sketching the following quadratic function. Also find its domain and range: \(f(x) = 6 - x - x^2\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh quadratic function hai, is ka graph parabola hota hai. \(a < 0\) hai, is liye parabola neeche (ulta U) khulta hai aur us ka vertex maximum point hoga.
Humein graph sketch karna hai, vertex mark karna hai, aur domain aur range batani hai. Sketch (khaka) ka matlab hai ke har point naap tol kar lagane ki zaroorat nahin, lekin vertex aur intercepts sahih jagah par hon.
Plan: \(h = -\frac{b}{2a}\) aur \(k = f(h)\) se vertex, phir intercepts, phir vertex ke dono taraf values ki table, aur aakhir mein graph se domain aur range parhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 6 - x - x^2\), yani \(a = -1,\ b = -1,\ c = 6\). Pehle terms ko aam tarteeb mein likh lein: \(f(x) = -x^2 - x + 6\); is se \(a, b, c\) pehchanne mein ghalti nahin hoti.
Humein find karna hai: sketch se maximum point, domain aur range.
Tareeqa: parabola teen cheezon se pehchana jata hai: kis taraf khulta hai, vertex kahan hai, aur chand points. Vertex woh mor (turning point) hai jahan curve palat-ta hai; yahi maximum ya minimum point hota hai.

Parabola kis taraf khulta hai
\[a = -1 \Rightarrow a < 0\]
Kyun: agar \(a > 0\) ho to parabola ooper khulta hai, jaise muskurahat, aur vertex sab se neecha point hota hai; agar \(a < 0\) ho to neeche khulta hai, jaise udaas chehra, aur vertex sab se ooncha point hota hai. Yahan parabola neeche (ulta U) khulta hai, is liye humein maximum talaash karna hai.

Vertex \((h, k)\)
\[h = -\dfrac{-1}{2(-1)} = -\dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[k = 6 - \left(-\tfrac{1}{2}\right) - \tfrac{1}{4}\]
\[k = \tfrac{24}{4} + \tfrac{2}{4} - \tfrac{1}{4} = \tfrac{25}{4}\]
Vertex \(V\left(-\tfrac{1}{2},\ \tfrac{25}{4}\right)\); axis of symmetry (tanazur ki lakeer) \(x = -\tfrac{1}{2}\).
Kyun: vertex hamesha axis of symmetry \(x = -\frac{b}{2a}\) par hota hai, aur us ki oonchai \(f(h)\) hai. Completing square se bhi yahi milta hai: \(f(x) = -\left(x + \tfrac{1}{2}\right)^2 + \tfrac{25}{4}\).
Dhyan dein: formula mein \(b\) ka sign samet istemal karein; \(-\frac{b}{2a}\) mein do minus mil kar plus bhi ban sakte hain.

Intercepts (axes ko kaatne wale points)
\[f(0) = 6\]
\[-x^2 - x + 6 = 0\]
\[x^2 + x - 6 = 0\]
\[(x + 3)(x - 2) = 0\]
\[x = -3 \text{ or } x = 2\]
y-intercept \((0, 6)\); x-intercepts \((-3, 0)\) aur \((2, 0)\).
Kyun: y-axis par har point ka \(x = 0\) hota hai, aur x-axis par \(f(x) = 0\). In points se graph ki jagah pakki ho jati hai.

Values ki table
\[x:\ -3,\ -2,\ -1,\ -0.5,\ 0,\ 1,\ 2\]
\[f(x):\ 0,\ 4,\ 6,\ 6.25,\ 6,\ 4,\ 0\]
Kyun: vertex ke dono taraf \(x\) ki values li hain. Dekhiye, outputs \(x = -\tfrac{1}{2}\) ke dono taraf aaine ki tarah dohraye ja rahe hain; yeh symmetry hamare hisaab ki tasdeeq bhi hai. Agar kahin values barabar na aayein to hisaab dobara dekhein.

Sketch
Points ko graph par lagayein, unhein smooth curve se jorein (seedhi lakeeron se nahin) aur dashed line \(x = -\tfrac{1}{2}\) bana dein (figure dekhiye). Mor ka point \(V\left(-\tfrac{1}{2},\ \tfrac{25}{4}\right)\) hai.
Kyun: graph saaf dikhata hai ke curve vertex se ooper kabhi nahin jata, is liye \(V\) hi maximum point hai. Exam mein graph par vertex, axis of symmetry aur intercepts ke labels zaroor likhein; yahi cheezein marks dilati hain.

Domain aur range
\[\text{Domain } f = (-\infty,\ \infty)\]
\[\text{Range } f = \left(-\infty,\ \tfrac{25}{4}\right]\]
Kyun: polynomial mein koi bhi real \(x\) rakha ja sakta hai, na koi denominator hai na square root, is liye domain tamam real numbers hain. Outputs vertex ki oonchai \(\tfrac{25}{4}\) se shuru hote hain (yeh value \(x = -\tfrac{1}{2}\) par waqai milti hai, is liye square bracket) aur neeche be-had tak jate hain, yani \(f(x) \le \tfrac{25}{4}\).
Dhyan dein: infinity ki taraf hamesha gol bracket lagta hai, kyun ke infinity koi number nahin jo haasil ho sake.

Tasdeeq
\[f(x) = -\left(x + \tfrac{1}{2}\right)^2 + \tfrac{25}{4}\]
Kyun: is square wali shakal ko khol kar dekhein to wapas \(6 - x - x^2\) milta hai, aur is se seedha nazar aata hai ke maximum value \(\tfrac{25}{4}\) hai; yeh sketch se mil gaya.
Khud sochiye: \(-x^2\) ka matlab \(-(x^2)\) hai. Is liye \(x = -3\) par \(-x^2 = -9\) hota hai, \(+9\) nahin; table banate waqt yeh sab se aam ghalti hai.
blocks.final_answer: Maximum point \(V\left(-\tfrac{1}{2},\ \tfrac{25}{4}\right)\), yani maximum value \(\tfrac{25}{4}\) jo \(x = -\tfrac{1}{2}\) par hai; Domain \(f = (-\infty,\ \infty)\); Range \(f = \left(-\infty,\ \tfrac{25}{4}\right]\).
